title: Gideon Jura | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about Gideon Jura, a Planeswalker who doesn't hesitate to enter combat to defend the innocent in Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: A powerful warrior-mage with the ability to make himself invulnerable, Gideon is fiercely loyal, unyielding, just, charismatic and never hesitates to enter combat to defend the innocent.
